name: marathon-escudo-vivo
description: MVP de autenticacion NFC para jerseys Marathon - monorepo

scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @mev/domain && npm run test -w @mev/nfc-contracts
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres mailpit
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run build -w @mev/domain && npm run build -w @mev/nfc-contracts && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
